229. The leftist is oriented toward largescale

>	Hoffer's short philosophical book was published very soon after Adorno

>"narrow-mindedness" with "right-wing" (hardly surprising, since the
>study was done so soon after World War II, and Adorno was politically

>
>	Hoffer's book went a long way toward countering Adorno's error,
>pointing out that there are fanatics in all religions and ideologies,

>has expanded upon this.  An important book (edited by Christie and

>	Nevertheless, Adorno's work endures for several reasons.  First,
>because it opened the topic for post-war social science, even though it
